# Zohaib — Portfolio & Video Editing Concept Studies

> Zohaib is a media student and video editor exploring how editing, color, and sound turn a collection of shots into a story. Known for patient pacing, intentional cuts, and evocative visual mood.

## Overview
- **Name**: Zohaib

- **Tagline**: Every frame. A feeling. / The story is in the cut.
- **Availability**: Exploring film, editing, and student collaborations

## Core Disciplines & Focus
- **Edit Direction & Pacing**: Crafting emotional arcs through sustained shots, breathing room, and rhythmic cuts.
- **Visual Rhythm**: Syncing pacing with ambient music, urban cadence, and movement.
- **Color Grading & Mood**: Using color palettes, warm highlights, and cool reflections to transform the emotional weight of a scene.
- **Atmospheric Sound Beds**: Pairing visuals with immersive soundscapes to amplify story impact.

## Selected Case Studies

- [Somewhere, Still.](https://zohaib-inmotion.web.app/work/somewhere-still): Short film concept study (2026). A quiet road and open horizon exploring patient pacing, warm highlights, and restrained cuts across distance and quiet spaces.
- [After Hours](https://zohaib-inmotion.web.app/work/after-hours): Social edit concept study (2026). Urban night rhythm contrasting red streetlights with cool reflections, moving between wide establishing shots and rapid macro details.
- [Feel the Frequency](https://zohaib-inmotion.web.app/work/feel-the-frequency): Music film concept study (2026). Visual performance energy focused on silhouettes, negative space, and dynamic cuts following the emotional contour of live audio.

## Creative Process
1. **Find the story**: Define intent, audience emotions, footage references, and core theme.
2. **Build the rhythm**: Shape the assembly cut, establish temporal pacing, and determine which moments must breathe.
3. **Make it feel**: Integrate color grade, audio layering, and motion dynamics with iterative feedback.
4. **Make the final cut**: Polish transitions, fine-tune frame-accurate cuts, and deliver high-fidelity exports.
